text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio gave it everything she had, but 
unfortunately missed out on 1st place.

Tokai Teio is overwhelmed with sorrow, 
knowing she can no longer become a "Triple 
Crown Umamusume" standing alongside 
Symboli Rudolf.

Her Trainer offered words of 
encouragement: "Even if you can't run 
beside them, you can still overtake them."

With renewed determination, Tokai Teio 
began relentless, non-stop training in 
preparation for the upcoming Nippon Derby.
